name: @alexa-control/mac-agent
description: Trusted governed macOS execution endpoint for Alexa Control.
author: Alexa Control

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && tsup --config tsup.config.ts && pnpm run build:native
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build:icons && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:native: pnpm run build:native-voice && pnpm run build:native-whisper-capture && pnpm run build:native-context && pnpm run build:native-interaction
scripts.dev:prepare-native: test -x dist-native/AlexaVoiceSTT.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-voice-stt && test -x dist-native/AlexaWhisperCapture.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-whisper-capture && test -x dist-native/AlexaActiveContext.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-active-context && test -x dist-native/AlexaInteraction.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-interaction || pnpm run build:native
scripts.build:native-voice: rm -rf dist-native/AlexaVoiceSTT.app && mkdir -p dist-native/AlexaVoiceSTT.app/Contents/MacOS && swiftc native/VoiceRecognition.swift -framework Speech -framework AVFoundation -o dist-native/AlexaVoiceSTT.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-voice-stt && cp native/AlexaVoiceSTT-Info.plist dist-native/AlexaVoiceSTT.app/Contents/Info.plist && node scripts/sign-native-app.mjs dist-native/AlexaVoiceSTT.app
scripts.build:native-whisper-capture: rm -rf dist-native/AlexaWhisperCapture.app && mkdir -p dist-native/AlexaWhisperCapture.app/Contents/MacOS && swiftc native/WhisperCapture.swift -framework AVFoundation -o dist-native/AlexaWhisperCapture.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-whisper-capture && cp native/AlexaWhisperCapture-Info.plist dist-native/AlexaWhisperCapture.app/Contents/Info.plist && node scripts/sign-native-app.mjs dist-native/AlexaWhisperCapture.app
scripts.build:native-context: rm -rf dist-native/AlexaActiveContext.app && mkdir -p dist-native/AlexaActiveContext.app/Contents/MacOS && swiftc native/ActiveContext.swift -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -o dist-native/AlexaActiveContext.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-active-context && cp native/AlexaActiveContext-Info.plist dist-native/AlexaActiveContext.app/Contents/Info.plist && node scripts/sign-native-app.mjs dist-native/AlexaActiveContext.app
scripts.build:native-interaction: rm -rf dist-native/AlexaInteraction.app && mkdir -p dist-native/AlexaInteraction.app/Contents/MacOS && swiftc native/SemanticInteraction.swift -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -framework CryptoKit -o dist-native/AlexaInteraction.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-interaction && cp native/AlexaInteraction-Info.plist dist-native/AlexaInteraction.app/Contents/Info.plist && node scripts/sign-native-app.mjs dist-native/AlexaInteraction.app
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare-native && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174" "tsup --config tsup.config.ts --watch" "wait-on tcp:5174 file:dist-electron/main.cjs dist-native/AlexaActiveContext.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-active-context dist-native/AlexaVoiceSTT.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-voice-stt dist-native/AlexaWhisperCapture.app/Contents/MacOS/alexa-whisper-capture && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron ."

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Alexa Mac Agent uses the camera only when you start the local governed gesture runtime.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Alexa Mac Agent uses the microphone only when you start local voice input.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Alexa Mac Agent uses on-device speech recognition only when explicitly enabled.
